notes: Printed below the table: 'Source: Metcalf & Eddy, 2003'.

Transcriber layout note: every header cell is printed on two or three lines inside one ruled header row ('COD' / 'Loading' / '(kg/m3/day)'). The printed lines are joined with single spaces and the printed exponents are written as superscripts.
Only one data row is printed and there is no stub column; the seven cells are the whole table.
Printed 'F/M as MLVSS' carries no unit; no unit is added.
Printed 'Flux (l/m2/day)' uses a lower-case letter l; retained.
Unit case varies inside the same table ('mg/l' beside 'kPa'); retained as printed.
Printed ranges use a short hyphen throughout ('1.2-3.2', '5,000-20,000'); retained.
